set.body: Implement and qualify bounded pointwise common-center sign-flip inference for independent symmetric subject contrast errors conditional on selection and precisions. Native ScalaFIM owns the scientific contract; reuse the existing resample4s core 6bc4172 public random streams. Exact enumeration and identity-corrected Monte Carlo, subject-bound reusable plans, explicit equal or fixed-precision weighting, no nuisance/repeated-row or spatial multiplicity admission. Independent rational/decimal full-orbit references, portable regressions, predeclared held-out null/power and confidence-set coverage, fresh confirmation of the largest Monte Carlo deviation, and completed-work resource evidence. Parent admission remains open for covariate-adjusted alternatives and general consumer defaults.
